text:
- Past escher's scrub: the chained std panic hook prints the raw panic message to stderr, and the allowlisted `log.file` can still carry a host path, now only for a bridged `log` record under an engine target (`js_console`) — the bridged third-party records that carried one at `RUST_LOG=info` (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-telemetry-bootstrap/report.md) are dropped whole since 2026-10-07-sink-target-allowlist (recorded by construction, not measured: a dropped record writes zero bytes, and `log.file` occurrences were not counted in that chunk's readings). A record from a target outside the sink's allowlist no longer reaches stderr at all (Scrubbing, below) — measured before → after the drop on both sink-installing binaries at four `RUST_LOG` settings, as stderr lines and as the instrument's fixed id and name needles found: the `escher-session` binary (the CRUD task, one `hello`, then `stop`) 0 → 0 lines unset (the default `warn`), 1 → 1 at `info`, 1165 → 1 at `debug` with ids 15 of 15 → 0, 1501 → 1 at `trace` with ids 15 of 15 → 0 and names 6 of 6 → 0; the windowed `seven_guis_native` (left on Home for 10 s, nobody clicks — its first reading by level) 1 → 0 lines unset, 3 → 1 at `info`, 12,413 → 1 at `debug` with ids 11 of 11 → 0, 47,482 → 1 at `trace` with ids 11 of 11 → 0 and names 5 of 5 → 0; the one line left at `info`, `debug` and `trace` is the install line `INFO escher_telemetry`, and stdout is 0 bytes in all 16 readings.
 Typed text was first measured in process: since 2026-10-07-act-by-id a typing command exists — the driver's `type`, through `Session::run` — and types into an instance held in process; `stand_act_spans`'s re-run child drove the six instance-level verbs of that day, `type` included, with the sink installed over a capture at `RUST_LOG=info`, in both layout modes, and the capture holds 0 of 36 id needles, 0 of 8 name needles and 0 occurrences of the three supplied texts (the typed text, the id naming no element, the unknown verb's text), with no value reading redacted on a driver line; the verb table held seven since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot, when `stand_act_spans` also began checking a refused shot's `fonts-unavailable` cause on the span, and holds eight with the `lint` verb, whose accepted line and refused no-font line `stand_act_spans` also reads (36 calls per mode, eight verbs read back, two part reads among them — part 1, and part 2 of the shared `many_items` page held as `paged`, read as `Outcome::Part` with at least 2 parts, its 400 `item-NNN` ids and its buttons' text joining the id and name needles (`Needles::read`), none on a captured line — each line `verb` alone). A shot's image is screen content that leaves only in its answer: 0 occurrences of the first 64 base64 characters of a shot in the `escher-session` host's and the `mcp` role's stderr at `trace`, under both builds (`host_log`, `mcp_log`; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md).
 Typed text in a HOST's log is measured since 2026-10-10-driver-cli: a hosted `type` reaches the `escher-session` host's instance, and that host's stderr at `RUST_LOG=trace` holds 0 occurrences of the typed sentinel, 0 id needles and 0 name needles under both builds (`host_log` green as `-p seven_guis` and as `--workspace`); by level, on a snapshot · click · type flow with three commands, the host built alone writes 0 lines unset and 4 at `info`, `debug` and `trace` — three command-span lines and the install line, 742 B — and the workspace-built host 5, one `blitz_dom::document` INFO line more, 860 B, with 0 of 15 id needles, 0 of 6 name needles and 0 sentinel occurrences at every level and stdout 0 B in all eight runs (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/evidence/by-level.md); since 2026-10-14-quality-gates the three readings that left out are taken too — a client's own stderr (a one-off reading; a standing check below), the host on flows beyond those three commands, and the windowed `seven_guis_native` built with the workspace, on the host's display (`wayland-1`) — 28 runs by build and level, 0 needles in every run (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-quality-gates/evidence/stderr-by-level.md); re-measured at 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep on the same flow, the host built alone is unchanged (4 lines, 742 B) and the workspace-built host writes 6 lines, 978 B — the `blitz_dom::document` `focussed node` INFO line now printing twice where it printed once, its message `[redacted]` — with the id, name and typed-sentinel needles still 0 at `info` and `trace` under both builds (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep/evidence/log-counts.md).
 A recording session's clients are read by a standing check: `host_log`'s third test (unix only) runs each client command through `common::run` at `RUST_LOG=trace` — `start crud --record`, `type` with a sentinel, `snapshot`, `snapshot --part 1`, `lint`, `stop` — in the state directories `hl-client` and `hl-client-rec`, guarded by `common::Started`, and over all the clients' own stderr reads 0 id, 0 name, 0 sentinel, 0 recording-path and 0 `recorded_needles` occurrences under both builds (`host_log` 3, green as `-p seven_guis` and as `--workspace`); a paged `part` read through the `escher-session` host's own sink is read by its fourth test (unix only), which runs `serve cells` at `RUST_LOG=trace` in `hl-cells`, commits a sentinel into a part-2 cell and calls `snapshot --part 2`: 0 id and 0 name needles under both builds, its failures naming a kind and a count only (`host_log` 4) (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-24-stand-requirement-sweep/report.md, the part read at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar/report.md).
 The session host's reading above, of a host that runs no call, was re-measured unchanged at 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans — 0 · 1 · 1 · 1 stderr lines, ids 0 of 15, names 0 of 6, stdout 0 B (the readings above as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-sink-target-allowlist/evidence/by-level.md; the typing command at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-act-by-id/report.md; the in-process capture and the re-measurement at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md).
 The sink allowlist re-checked after the upstream take read at `ebacd68bd` holds: no scrub set, redaction shape or violation schema moves, `packages/escher-telemetry/` and `packages/escher-driver/` unchanged and dioxus-native-dom taking one test alone (`input_focused_on_mount_enables_ime`); `host_log` and `mcp_log` (the host's and the `mcp` role's stderr at `trace`, read for id, name and typed-sentinel needles) pass in the per-package and the workspace build; the fixed-sha census over the taken commits' `packages/*.rs` lines reads its two named hits, blitz-dom holds 0 wall-clock reads outside `clock.rs`, and the take adds no log site, span, field, log field or env read in source — the uncaught-JS-error `tracing::error!` stands whole in `report_js_error` (`runtime/events.rs`), still `#[cfg(feature = "tracing")]` under the engine target `blitz_vibey_script`, the sink printing its safe fields and the message `[redacted]`; `pseudo_element_flow_classification` reads 0 env · 0 print · 0 subscriber (as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-27-upstream-sync-engine-debts/evidence/sink.md)

subject: pii
text:
- escher's own sink applies an allowlist of targets in its formatter (packages/escher-telemetry/src/format.rs:22-111) — two public prefix sets, three outcomes: an event whose target — or a bridged `log` record's `log.target` — starts with `blitz`, `dioxus_native`, `stylo_taffy`, `accesskit_xplat`, `debug_timer` or `js_console` (`ENGINE_TARGET_PREFIXES`) prints only `node_id`, `status`, `waiting_nodes`, `property`, `log.module_path`, `log.file`, `log.line`, every other field (the message included) as `{name}=[redacted]`; an event whose target starts with `escher_` (`ESCHER_TARGET_PREFIXES` — the underscore is part of the prefix: `escher_telemetry`, `escher_telemetry::panic`, `escher_driver` and `escher_stand_probe` are admitted, `escher` alone is not) prints every field except `url`, `href`, `src`, `html`, `text`, `value`, `attrs`, `path`, `request`, `error` and `panic.payload`, which are redacted; an event from any other target is dropped whole before anything is written — no time, no target, no newline — at every level, WARN and ERROR included, and whatever `RUST_LOG` names (packages/escher-telemetry/src/format.rs:144-148); since 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans a closed span's line is judged pair by pair by the same rule — its name (`span`), its own fields and the layer's `message`, `time.busy` and `time.idle`: under an escher target every pair prints unless its name is in the content-named set, under an engine target only the safe fields print and the rest, `span` and the three close fields among them, read `[redacted]`, and a span from any other target writes no byte at creation, on a recorded value, on enter, on exit or on close; the value of a content-named span field is never stored (the marker is written at print time), and every other span field's value is held in process memory until the span closes;
 the five scrub sets and the rule are unchanged, and `escher_driver` now has two emitters, the command span (§4) and, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, the `tool_call` span (§4), neither of whose two fields, `tool` and `ending`, is in the content-named set — both print, both closed words — its closed-span line ratified by the founder (2026-10-09), as §6 → Log format states (packages/escher-telemetry/src/format.rs:97-111; packages/escher-telemetry/src/format.rs:162-173; packages/escher-telemetry/src/format.rs:200-250; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md); no engine call site is edited

text: - Its reach is that sink, installed by the two binaries of the seven_guis package (`seven_guis_native`, `escher-session`): in both the engine `tracing` features stay off in a package-alone build (`-p seven_guis`), so engine events reach it only when one is turned on — which a workspace-wide build does for blitz-dom (§2 → Feature wiring); a record from any target outside the two prefix sets — Stylo's `style::*`, `selectors::matching`, `dioxus_core::*` and `dioxus_signals::*` on both binaries, and on the windowed stand also `naga::*`, `wgpu_core::*`, `wgpu_hal::*`, `winit_wayland::*`, `sctk` and `calloop::*` — is dropped, delivered by the route entry "Sink target allowlist" (the founder's ruling, 2026-10-07; Values logged as-is, above); the cost is that a third-party WARN or ERROR no longer reaches stderr at any setting — the windowed stand's one default-level line, `WARN winit_wayland::window::state`, no longer prints (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-sink-target-allowlist/evidence/by-level.md); the upstream apps' `fmt::init()` stdout subscribers and the WPT runner's `env_logger` stay unscrubbed, and the values above remain logged as-is there

text: - The cold-agent pipe log (§3) sits outside that sink and carries no user content: no event or verdict key is in the content-named set, and no transcript text, tool argument, tool answer, reply or check enters an event or the verdict (two contract tests over four planted markers); the stub's call log is retired with the stub (2026-10-15-cold-agent-test). `target/cold-agent/server.log` is escher's sink output (the allowlist formatter's redaction), counted by span name and never printed or copied; `check.json` holds the agent's check — stand fixture ids and texts — never printed. Its `target/cold-agent/transcript.jsonl` is raw model output and tool I/O, unscrubbed by design — since 2026-10-15-cold-agent-test the stand's screen from the escher server (element ids, accessible names and control values in snapshot texts and diffs), carried to the model provider on the founder's «Один запуск, до $3 (Рекомендую)» (2026-10-15, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label; confirmed at that chunk's wrap card, «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)») — — and on the live run of six apps also Cells' contents, the flight booker's select options and value, a lint's findings and a shot (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar/report.md) — and it also holds host paths (init `cwd`, `memory_paths`), the client's local socket path and a rate-limit line; never printed or logged, gitignored under `target/`; each committed copy (the live runs' evidence) masks the session dir and the home prefix (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-cold-agent-run-pipe/report.md and escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-15-cold-agent-test/report.md — live events and verdict held 0 scrub-set keys)

text: | Recording directory | the directory a session's launcher names by `--record` (or `Session::recording_into`) — created `0700` with its parent existing, refused `record-dir-not-private` when open to its group or others — holding one `check-{n}.json` (`0600`, `create_new`, never replaced) per recorded session, rewritten whole after every call through `.check-{n}.json.tmp` (`0600`) and a rename, removed by the recorder only when its recording ends on a failed write or a passed bound (400 records, 1,048,576 bytes) and otherwise never removed by escher; it holds call content at rest — target ids, a `press` key, an `advance`'s ms, unmasked typed text, a `type` to a masked or unresolved control as `masked` — with each call's `accepted`, its answer digest and the answer kept whole as `answer` — the line the driver wrote, masked as on every carrier, a shot's as `{width, height}` without `png` — so the screens' ids, names, values, snapshot text, diffs and a lint's findings at rest, and no log or event line; unix only; local only, uploaded by no CI leg; the checks write theirs under `target/tmp/`, and the cold-agent pipe's live `escher-session mcp --record` child its own under `target/cold-agent/record/` (the next two rows) | (packages/escher-driver/src/recording.rs:153-164; packages/escher-driver/src/recording.rs:259-271; packages/escher-driver/src/session.rs:166-190) |
